extracted.intended_audience: authors seeking literary representation / writers querying agents
extracted.subtask_description: A feed of literary agents' short wishlist posts describing the kinds of manuscripts or proposals they want and how they accept queries (genres, example titles, submission channel). Useful for authors tailoring submissions to specific agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive middle grade fantasy novels
rubrics_metrics.description: "Send me inventive middle grade fantasy novels."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agent examples of comparable titles: THE GIRL WHO DRANK THE MOON, WHEN YOU TRAP A TIGER, THE LAND OF STORIES, and THE SCHOOL FOR GOOD AND EVIL. Tagged #MSWL, Fantasy, MG — implies submissions should be middle-grade in age-target, fantasy genre, and have an inventive/original hook or approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonfiction proposals offering a new perspective on entertaining topics
rubrics_metrics.description: "I want nonfiction proposals that offer a new perspective on an entertaining topic in any of these categories: art, the environment, pop culture, science, psychology, cultural history, and the occult."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should present a fresh/novel angle on an engaging subject. Acceptable topical categories explicitly listed: art; the environment; pop culture; science; psychology; cultural history; the occult. Emphasis on both 'new perspective' (original argument/approach) and 'entertaining topic' (readable/accessible appeal).

rubrics_metrics.name: Query submission channel preference (QueryTracker only)
rubrics_metrics.description: "I only accept queries via Querytracker: querytracker.net/query/MacLysaght"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agent requires queries be submitted through the specified QueryTracker form/link. Note provided that the link will open May 15th, 2026 — implies time-bound availability; do not send queries via other channels or before the stated open date.
